main_text.p: ergo sententia eorum est bona. Impiè viuunt: ergo & malè sentiunt qui spiritualem sensum in cœna Domini tuentur. Hæc & similia multa, quæ splendidis amplificationibus & exornationibus (vt phaleræ ad populum) ostentantur, dum altius mecum reputo & perpendo, demiror attonitus, quomodo nugæ plusquàm aniles tā persuaderi dementer, quàm temerè creditæ in opinione hominū etiam doctissimorum vsque adeò pertinaciter atque diu hærere potuerint. Continere igitur me non valeo, quin illud Ethnici Poëtæ in ἀδολεσχίαν & ἀ-περαντολογίαν vitilitigatorum exclamē,

Video enim huic controuersiæ haud secus accidisse ac cæteris rebus magnis, famæ aliqua ex parte obnoxiis, solet contingere, quas multa plerunque vana & inania, vt phalangem in acie leuis armatura, comitantur. Vbi mihi in mentē [?] venit eiꝰ dicti quod Plutarchus grauis autor alicubi scribit, ὡς πολέμως [?], ἢ ἀπεχάσεως [?] πολλὰ τὰ ναυά [?]

page.notes: The Greek line at the end of the second paragraph is only partly legible and is printed in italics; the uncertain words are marked [?]. The word "mentē" (or similar) after "in" is hard to read and is marked [?]. The "ꝰ" in "eiꝰ" is printed as an abbreviation and is kept as printed. The "ἀ-" / "περαντολογίαν" hyphenation is printed across the line break. The left-edge fragments are from the neighbouring page and are not transcribed.
